item.title: IRGC dismantles two terrorist teams in southeast Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) has dismantled two terrorist teams and arrested their members in the southeastern cities of Saravan and Iranshahr, foiling planned attacks, the IRGC Ground Force’s Quds Headquarters said on Tuesday.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86305261/IRGC-dismantles-two-terrorist-teams-in-southeast-Iran

Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) has dismantled two terrorist teams and arrested their members in the southeastern cities of Saravan and Iranshahr, foiling planned attacks, the IRGC Ground Force’s Quds Headquarters said on Tuesday.

item.title: Iran to UNSC: Israel possesses nuclear weapons, yet you are concerned about absence of inspectors in Iran!
item.description: New York, IRNA – Iran’s Ambassador and Chargé d’Affaires to the United Nations Gholamhossein Darzi has criticized the silence of the Western members of the UN Security Council regarding the crimes committed by the US and Israel against Iran, saying that the International Atomic Energy Agency is not a tool for extracting concessions or advancing geopolitical agendas while wondering Israel possesses nuclear weapons, the UNSC is concerned about the absence of inspectors in Iran!
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86305296/Iran-to-UNSC-Israel-possesses-nuclear-weapons-yet-you-are-concerned

New York, IRNA – Iran’s Ambassador and Chargé d’Affaires to the United Nations Gholamhossein Darzi has criticized the silence of the Western members of the UN Security Council regarding the crimes committed by the US and Israel against Iran, saying that the International Atomic Energy Agency is not a tool for extracting concessions or advancing geopolitical agendas while wondering Israel possesses nuclear weapons, the UNSC is concerned about the absence of inspectors in Iran!

item.title: Pezeshkian says US military intervention in Persian Gulf disrupts global energy markets
